field_policy: Keep every authored, validated field and nested value. No allowlist, default insertion, trimming, sorting, normalization, inferred parent, or date-to-string conversion.

provenance.title: Exact source title
provenance.description: Empty: the AC schema has no description field; full criteria remains metadata.criteria. This preserves existing progressive-disclosure summary semantics.

baseline.reason: New extractor module absent before implementation

schema_comparison.assertion: Full authored fixture equals extracted metadata after YAML safe_dump and canonical source validation

negative_control.mutation: Remove criteria from extracted metadata in memory
negative_control.result: Full-field source fidelity test raises AssertionError

validation.lint: ruff check passed; ruff format applied
controls: All 47 authored scalar, list, object, and nullable fields survive exact extraction
Nested list-object correlation, duplicate array entries, whitespace, false, zero, null, empty list and empty object survive
Bare YAML date remains date and quoted date-like text remains string
Absent optional fields and schema defaults stay absent
Configured custom source path is used and index/scaffolding mappings are excluded
Invalid criteria, undeclared fields, unknown components, and unresolved required AC dependencies fail existing validation
Duplicate AC ids fail rather than collapse
Resolved source paths outside supplied snapshot are rejected before validation reads
Fresh extraction cannot inherit mutations to previous result metadata

integration_boundary: Shared native-property encoding, graph publication, immutable source pinning, and Aura verification are performed by the parent integration task. This module performs no Neo4j writes.
